The corresponding SDK source is in openhongguo-0.2.0-source.zip. Native rebuild instructions are in bindings/mobile/README.md and build.sh inside it (Go 1.26+, gomobile, Android NDK and JDK 17+). The main app can build using the pinned precompiled AAR included in app/libs.
